Locally hosted to keep navigation and quiz controls usable when Google Fonts is
unavailable. Subset with fontTools to the symbol names present in src/ and
index.html, with opsz=24, wght=400, FILL=0, GRAD=0. No app runtime dependency.
When adding a new symbol, regenerate the subset or provide its local SVG.
